newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $298 mln for Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $298 mln for Thursday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Thursday, May 1 are expected to total $298 million in 19 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $165 million in seven sales, with a $39 million NYS Dormitory Authority deal through Cain Brothers & Co., Inc. topping the list.
On the competitive side, 12 sales totaling $133 million are on the schedule. A $35 million Fort Lauderdale, Fla., deal at 1100 EDT is the largest.
